daily.today_energy: The Moon's in your sign, so you're feeling yourself—grounded and present. Saturn retrograde is asking you to revisit some boundaries you've set, while Mars conjunct Jupiter in Leo is pumping up the volume on ambition. It's a lot of fire energy, so channel it wisely.
daily.love: Venus sextile Jupiter is softening things in romance. If you've been hesitant about someone, today feels lighter and more open. Single? You're giving off approachable energy. Just make sure you're being real and not just charming your way through conversations.
daily.career: Mars-Jupiter conjunction has you feeling capable and ready to take on more. The Sun squaring both though means don't overcommit just to prove something. Quality over quantity. This is a good day to propose ideas, but sleep on the big decisions.
daily.health: Your energy is high but scattered with all this fire around. Grounding practices like a walk or yoga will help more than pushing yourself hard at the gym. Listen to what your body actually needs, not what you think it should want.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is asking you to slow down and listen to what your intuition's been trying to tell you. Mercury's vibes suggest clarity is coming, but only if you're willing to sit with the discomfort first. Trust the process.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or flying solo, this is about authenticity over performance. Someone might be trying to get your attention, but the real invitation is to show up as your actual self. No cap, that's the move.
weekly.career: Your creative energy is peaking, even if it doesn't feel like it yet. This is the week to pitch that idea you've been workshopping or take on a project that actually excites you. Small momentum builds into something real.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for grounding this week—whether that's walks, stretching, or just being more present in your day. Energy levels might feel scattered, so lean into what makes you feel centered and whole.
